easy: A big room where many people meet to listen or watch.

ex.en: Dad grinds coffee beans every morning.

ex.ko: 피자를 여덟 조각으로 나누는 일은 쉬웠다.

ex.ko: 우리는 매일 저녁 함께 밥을 먹는다.

ex.ko: 우리는 보드게임을 하며 즐거운 저녁을 보냈다.

easy: A trip in an airplane.

ex.en: Our flight to Seoul took many hours.

easy: A set of steps that go from one floor to the next.

ex.ko: 나는 계단을 두 층 올라가서 교실에 갔다.

easy: Being able to do, say, or think what you want without being stopped.

ex.ko: 나는 기린이 얼마나 크게 자라는지 구글로 검색했다.

easy: To ask someone questions for a news story or show.

ex.ko: 기자는 새 공원에 대해 우리 반을 인터뷰했다.

ex.ko: 사장님은 그 일자리에 세 사람을 면접했다.

ex.ko: 할아버지는 서재에 책을 수백 권 두신다.

ex.en: I borrowed three dinosaur books from the library.
ex.ko: 나는 도서관에서 공룡 책을 세 권 빌렸다.

easy: Being in a certain place.

ex.ko: 우리 학교는 공원 옆에 위치해 있다.

ex.en: The queen waved to the crowd from her carriage.

easy: The wife of a king.

easy: Being seated, or one stretch of time that you stay seated.

ex.ko: 나는 한자리에 앉아서 그 책을 다 읽었다.

ex.en: Mosquitoes lay eggs in standing water.

ex.ko: 우리 학교는 걸어서 갈 수 있는 거리에 있다.

easy: Moving on foot using your legs.

ex.ko: 학교까지 걷기는 나를 건강하게 해 준다.

ex.ko: 과학자들은 지구가 태양 주위를 돈다는 것을 받아들인다.

ex.ko: 나는 그 애의 파티 초대를 수락했다.

ex.ko: 우리는 장난감이 아닌 진짜 곰을 봤다.

easy: To come into view so that people can see it.

ex.en: A rainbow appeared after the rain.

easy: Having no money.

ex.en: I'm broke because I spent all my allowance.

easy: How far apart two things are.

ex.en: The distance between our houses is short.

easy: A place that is very far away.

ex.en: I saw a tiny boat far off in the distance.

easy: How far it is from one place to another.

ex.en: The distance from my house to school is one mile.

easy: Putting food in your mouth and swallowing it.

ex.en: Eating slowly is good for your stomach.

easy: Giving one thing and getting another thing back.

ex.ko: 나는 내 사과를 그 애의 쿠키와 교환했다.

easy: Thick and wide around.

easy: What you learn or discover by looking closely into something.

ex.en: The scientist shared her findings with the class.
ex.ko: 과학자는 자신의 조사 결과를 학급에 발표했다.

easy: A hard, clear material that breaks easily and is used in windows.

ex.en: The window is made of glass.

easy: A clear cup that you drink from.

ex.en: I filled my glass with cold water.
ex.ko: 나는 유리컵에 차가운 물을 가득 따랐다.

easy: As much as one drinking cup can hold.

ex.en: I drank a whole glass of milk.
ex.ko: 나는 우유를 한 잔 다 마셨다.

easy: Knowing a lot because of lots of study.

ex.ko: 그 박식한 교수님은 모든 질문의 답을 알고 계셨다.

easy: Picked up by practice or experience, not from birth.

ex.en: Brushing teeth is a learned habit.

easy: Able to move or be moved easily from place to place.

ex.ko: 이동 도서관 버스가 매주 우리 마을에 온다.

easy: In the north part of a place, or facing north.

easy: Coming from the north.

ex.en: A cold northern wind blew on my face.

easy: Not closed.

ex.ko: 길을 건널 때는 눈을 크게 뜨세요.

easy: Made so that people can go through.

ex.en: The newly opened road made the trip faster.
ex.ko: 새로 개통된 도로 덕분에 여행이 더 빨라졌다.

easy: Not closed up tight.

ex.en: The letter was already open when it came.
ex.ko: 편지는 도착했을 때 이미 열려 있었다.

easy: Put in a certain spot.

ex.en: The toys were placed neatly on the shelf.

easy: Having a lot of strength or force.

ex.en: A powerful wave knocked over my sandcastle.

easy: Having a lot of control over what other people do.

ex.en: The president is a powerful leader.

easy: Coming before in time.

ex.en: I could not come because of a prior plan.
ex.ko: 나는 먼저 잡힌 약속 때문에 갈 수 없었다.

easy: Keeping someone or something safe.

ex.en: The guard dog gave the farm protection at night.

easy: Something that covers you to keep you safe.

ex.en: A helmet is protection for your head.

easy: To get something that someone gives or sends you.

easy: To catch a signal, like on a radio or phone.

easy: Having to do with faith and beliefs about God.

easy: Believing strongly in God and showing respect for God.

ex.en: My grandmother is very religious and prays each day.

easy: To travel in a car, bus, or train.

ex.ko: 나는 매일 버스를 타고 학교에 간다.

easy: Having to do with a king or queen.

ex.en: The royal family waved from the balcony.

ex.en: The prince comes from a royal family.

easy: A big white surface where a movie is shown.

ex.en: We watched the movie on a giant screen.

easy: The flat part of a TV or computer where pictures show up.

easy: To be used as something.

ex.ko: 큰 바위는 의자로 쓰일 수 있다.

ex.en: Mom got a signed card from my teacher.

ex.ko: 교장 선생님은 조회 시간에 연설을 하셨다.

easy: The cars and trucks moving along the road.

ex.en: Traffic was slow because of the rain.

easy: Having clothes on your body.

ex.en: Wearing a seat belt keeps you safe.

easy: Making you very tired.

ex.en: The long hike was wearing for everyone.

easy: Very, very good.

ex.en: We had a wonderful day at the beach.

easy: Having the same opinion.

easy: A place where airplanes take off and land.

ex.en: We waited at the airport for Grandma's plane.

easy: To start at a certain time or place.

easy: The part underneath something.

ex.ko: 내 공이 언덕 맨 아래까지 굴러갔다.

easy: A machine that makes a car or truck move.

ex.en: The car engine made a loud noise.

easy: The front part of a train that pulls it along the tracks.

ex.en: The train engine blew its whistle.

easy: Known by many, many people.

easy: Putting money into something hoping to get more later.

ex.ko: 은행에 돈을 넣어 두는 것은 안전한 투자다.

easy: Money you put into something hoping to get more later.

ex.en: Grandpa's investment grew over the years.

easy: Time or hard work that you put into something.

ex.en: Practicing piano every day is an investment of time.

easy: Taking care of something for someone.

ex.en: I left my toy in my friend's keeping.

easy: To be in a certain place.

ex.en: The small town lies by a river.

easy: To rest flat with your body stretched out.

ex.en: I like to lie on the grass and watch clouds.
ex.ko: 나는 잔디에 누워 구름 보는 것을 좋아한다.

easy: Someone you are married to.

ex.ko: 엄마는 아빠의 배우자이고, 두 분은 함께 요리하신다.

easy: A person who works with you on something.

easy: One of the owners of a business they share.

easy: Unhappy, like you want to cry.

easy: Making people feel unhappy.

easy: In the south, or facing south.

easy: Coming from or found in places to the south.

ex.en: Penguins live in the Southern Hemisphere.

ex.en: I drew a square with my ruler.

easy: A number multiplied by itself.

ex.en: The square of four is sixteen.

easy: An open space in a town where streets meet.

ex.en: We fed pigeons in the town square.
ex.ko: 우리는 마을 광장에서 비둘기에게 먹이를 주었다.

easy: Blocked, so air cannot go through.

ex.en: My nose is stopped up because of a cold.

easy: Done the way people have done it for a very long time.

ex.ko: 우리는 설날에 전통 음식인 떡국을 먹는다.

easy: Two times.

ex.ko: 나는 오늘 이를 두 번 닦았다.

easy: Two times as much.

easy: Air that moves outside.

ex.en: The strong wind blew my hat away.

easy: A small coin that is worth very little. One hundred make a dollar.

ex.en: I found a cent on the sidewalk.
